MediaRequest Form
Submit your MRF at least 3 weeks in advance.
Respective departments must prepare the MRF and

Once approved, the director should email it to the

finalize it by the proposed deadline.

Execution Stage
Action Plan
The action plan is the final master document that facilitate
communication during the event day(s). It covers what
needs to be done pre-, during and post-event by the
manpower you have recruited. It should describe and
explain who do what at where and when.
To be drafted 1-2 weeks before the event.
It should be as detail as possible
What needs to be done in specific in what way and
when e.g. checking stocks of goodie bags and
merchandise and F&B
The timing for each task needs to be as specific as
possible
Even though there will be delays during the event,
having a pre-determined timing for each task to be
done also gives you the reference on what agenda
can be trimmed or can be extended in a reasonably
manner
It also serves as baseline reference to estimate how
likely your event is going to be delayed or on the right
track
